fee_notes: Marketing fee $1,500-$3,500/month (variable). Tech fee $250/month subject to increase. Non-compliance tech fee $750-$3,500/month. Additional fees for audits (greater of $10k or audit expenses), late fees ($250/week per item), insurance reimbursement, successor franchise fee (50% of current franchise fee), transfer fee (50-100% depending on broker involvement), additional training ($500/day), and onsite assistance ($500/day per person).
